title: Towards Multi-Stakeholder Evaluation of ML Models: A Crowdsourcing Study on Metric Preferences in Job-matching System
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith; therefore, there are no findings related to this topic. Its findings relate to how different demographic groups (based on age, race, education, income, etc.) prioritize different performance and fairness metrics in a job-matching context.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It conducted a crowdsourcing study to measure participants' preferences for different machine learning performance and fairness metrics (e.g., accuracy, precision, disparate impact) in a hypothetical job-matching system scenario. The protected attribute considered was race (Black/White).
